caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bed frame with four stout, turned posts at each corner, all of which have rounded finials on top. The wood is a warm, medium brown color with visible grain, giving a natural and polished appearance. The footboard is solid with a slight decorative curve at the top, while the headboard has both a solid upper panel and a lower section with a row of vertical spindles. The side and end rails of the bed are cylindrical and thick, connecting the posts firmly. Across the central frame where a mattress would rest, there is a grid of rope or cord fastened to form a mesh-like support. The background is a plain, lightly tinted surface with no other objects or details present. In the lower right corner, the name "ARCHIE THOMPSON" is printed in small, clear letters.
title: Bed: Bishop Hill
